Championship]]}} {{MedalBronze|[[2011 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship|2011 Spain]]|}} }} '''Joffrey Lauvergne''' (born 30 September 1991) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]] of the [[Basketball League of Serbia]] (KLS), the [[ABA League]], and the [[EuroLeague]]. He was drafted 55th overall by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] in the [[2013 NBA draft]], who then traded his rights to the [[Denver Nuggets]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-acquire-f-darrell-arthur-memphis-grizzlies|title=Nuggets Acquire F Darrell Arthur From Memphis Grizzlies|date=June 27, 2013|work=NBA.com|access-date=April 14, 2014}} ==Professional career== ===Élan Chalon (2009–2012)=== After two years in [[INSEP]] (2007–2009), Joffrey Lauvergne arrived in [[Chalon-sur-Saône]] in 2009. With [[Élan Chalon]] he won a [[LNB Pro A|French League]] in 2012, two [[French Basketball Cup|French Cup]]s in 2011 and 2012, and [[Leaders Cup]] in 2012. Lauvergne averaged 5.4 points and 3.4 rebounds per game in the French League. He was waived by the team on 25 November 2012.{{cite web|title=Elan Chalon waives Joffrey Lauvergne|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/96834/elan-chalon-waives-joffrey-lauvergne.html|work=Sportando|access-date=14 March 2014}} ===Valencia (2012)=== On 28 November, 2012, Lauvergne signed a short-term deal with the [[Liga ACB|ACB]] club [[Valencia BC|Valencia]].{{cite web|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/home/transactions/eurocup-2012-13/i/104405/7363/valencia-gets-lauvergne-on-short-term-deal |title=VALENCIA gets Lauvergne on short-term deal |work=eurocupbasketball.com |date=November 28, 2012 |access-date=September 11, 2013 |url-status=bot: unknown |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130107045118/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/home/transactions/eurocup-2012-13/i/104405/7363/valencia-gets-lauvergne-on-short-term-deal |archive-date=January 7, 2013 }} He averaged 5.8 points and 3.8 rebounds per game in five matches. ===Partizan (2012–2014)=== On 28 December, 2012, Lauvergne signed a two-and-a-half-year contract with [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]].{{cite news|url=http://www.kkpartizan.rs/sr/vest.php?id=1209 |title=Lovernj novi crno-beli! |language=sr |work=kkpartizan.rs |date=December 28, 2012 |access-date=June 28, 2013 |url-status=bot: unknown |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121231001928/http://www.kkpartizan.rs/sr/vest.php?id=1209 |archive-date=December 31, 2012 |last1=Normasoft. Net |first1=Normasoft }} After breakthrough half-season he was having in Partizan, he was drafted 55th overall by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] in the [[2013 NBA draft]], who then traded his rights to the [[Denver Nuggets]]. It was also announced that he will stay some time overseas before joining the NBA.{{cite web|last=Sherman|first=Roger|title=NBA Draft 2013: Denver Nuggets selects Joffrey Lauvergne with No. 55 pick|url=https://www.sbnation.com/nba/2013/6/28/4473188/nba-draft-2013-results-denver-nuggets-joffrey-lauvergne|work=sbnation.com|date=28 June 2013|access-date=14 March 2014}} Later in the summer of 2013, Lauvergne confirmed that he will stay with the club for another season, despite the financial problems the club was facing.{{cite web|title=Joffrey Lauvergne confirms he will stay with Partizan Belgrade|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/cups/adriatic-league/101510/joffrey-lauvergne-confirms-he-will-stay-with-partizan-belgrade.html|work=Sportando|access-date=14 March 2014}} In his second [[2013–14 Euroleague|EuroLeague]] season, with lot of trust from head coach [[Duško Vujošević]], he has made big steps forward in his development, becoming one of the best rebounders in the league averaging 9.3 rebounds in 10 regular season games. His games haven't gone unseen, as Denver Nuggets general manager [[Tim Connelly]] has said that they really liked the progress he has made through the season.{{cite web|last=Dempsey|first=Christopher|title=Nuggets have rising prospect in Europe's Joffrey Lauvergne|url= http://www.denverpost.com/2014/03/02/nuggets-have-rising-prospect-in-europes-joffrey-lauvergne/ |work=The Denver Post|date=2 March 2014|access-date=14 March 2014}} When team captain [[Dragan Milosavljević]] got injured, Lauvergne was appointed as new team captain. This made him first foreign captain in history of the Serbian team.{{cite web|title=Lovernj novi kapiten Partizana|url=http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2014&mm=01&dd=26&nav_id=804685|website=b92.net| date=26 January 2014 |access-date=21 June 2014|language=sr}} Over 24 games in the EuroLeague, he averaged 11.1 points per game, while also leading the league with 8.6 rebounds per game.{{cite web|last=Gancedo|first=Javier|title=Joffrey Lauvergne, Partizan NIS Belgrade|url=http://www.euroleague.net/features/interviews/euroleague-2013-14/i/127232/8232/joffrey-lauvergne-partizan-nis-belgrade|work=Euroleague.net|access-date=13 April 2014}}{{cite web|title=Joffrey Lauvergne 2013-2014 Statistics|url=http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=004194&seasoncode=E2013|work=Euroleague.net|access-date=13 April 2014}} Along with his teammate [[Bogdan Bogdanović (basketball)|Bogdan Bogdanović]], he was selected to [[ABA League Ideal Starting Five|the Ideal Team]] of the [[2013–14 ABA League]] season.{{cite web|title=The ideal five of the 2013/14 season selected |url=http://www.abaliga.com/a7487/News/The_ideal_five_of_the_2013/14_season_selected.html |work=abaliga.com |access-date=21 April 2014 |url-status=bot: unknown by winning its 13th consecutive title, defeating arch rivals [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] by 3–1 in the final series.{{cite web|title=Ništa novo, Partizan je šampion!|url=http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2014&mm=06&dd=21&nav_id=865626|website=b92.net| date=21 June 2014 |access-date=21 June 2014|language=sr}} Day after leaving Partizan, he left the farewell letter praising his old teammates, coaching staff, fans and Serbian people in general. He also stated that he was feeling like part of family, almost like at home, surrounded with love and care from the people in the club.{{cite news|title=Žo: Dragi prijatelji, ovo pismo je za vas |url=http://www.kkpartizan.rs/sr/vest.php?id=1632 |newspaper=Normacore.com |access-date=24 June 2014 |language=sr |url-status=bot: unknown |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140628113127/http://www.kkpartizan.rs/sr/vest.php?id=1632 |archive-date=28 June 2014 | last1=Normasoft. ''[[Večernje novosti]]'', Partizan also received US$600,000 in the name of buyout from Khimki, as Lauvergne was still under contract with Partizan.{{cite web|title=Lovernj dve godine u Himkiju, 2014|language=sr}} On 4 February, 2015, Lauvergne parted ways with Khimki.{{cite news|title=MERCI, JOFFREY!|url=http://en.bckhimki.ru/news/clubnews/2015/february/1041/|access-date=12 February 2015|work=bckhimki.ru|date=4 February 2015}} Over 27 games, he averaged 9.4 points, 4.4 rebounds and 1.1 assists per game. ===Denver Nuggets (2015–2016)=== On 19 February, 2015, Lauvergne signed a reported two-year deal with the [[Denver Nuggets]].{{cite web|title=Nuggets Sign Rookie Forward Joffrey Lauvergne|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-sign-rookie-forward-joffrey-lauvergne|work=NBA.com|date=February 19, 2015|access-date=February 19, 2015}}{{cite (2016–2017)=== [[File:Joffrey Lauvergne (32512012490).jpg|200px|thumb|right|Lauvergne with the Thunder in 2017]] On 30 August, 2016, Lauvergne was traded to the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] in exchange for two protected 2017 second round draft picks.{{cite web|title=Thunder Acquires Joffrey Lauvergne|url=http://www.nba.com/thunder/news/lauvergne-160830|work=NBA.com|date=August 30, 2016|access-date=August 30, 2016}} On 3 February, 2017, he scored a season-high 16 points in a 114–102 win over the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400900155|title=Westbrook's 38, triple-double lead Thunder past Grizzlies|work=ESPN.com|date=February 3, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2017}} ===Chicago Bulls (2017)=== On 23 February, 2017, Lauvergne was traded, along with [[Cameron Payne]] and [[Anthony Morrow]], to the [[Chicago Bulls]] in exchange for [[Taj Gibson]], [[Doug McDermott]] and a [[Mitchell Robinson|2018 second-round draft pick]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-acquire-payne-morrow-and-lauvergne-thunder|title=Bulls acquire Payne, Morrow, and Lauvergne from Thunder|work=NBA.com|date=February 23, 2017|access-date=February 23, 2017}} ===San Antonio Spurs (2017–2018)=== On 18 July, 2017, Lauvergne signed with the [[San Antonio Spurs]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-sign-joffrey-lauvergne|title=SPURS SIGN JOFFREY LAUVERGNE|work=NBA.com|date=July 18, 2017|access-date=July 18, 2017}} On February 13, 2018, he scored a career-high 26 points to go with a season-high 11 rebounds in a 117–109 loss to the [[Denver Nuggets]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400975598|title=Jokic's triple-double leads Nuggets over Spurs, 117-109|work=ESPN.com|date=February 13, 2018|access-date=February 14, 2018}} ===Fenerbahçe (2018–2020)=== On 4 July, 2018, Lauvergne signed a two-year deal with the Turkish club [[Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball|Fenerbahçe]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fenerbahce.org/eng/detay.asp?ContentID=4154|title=Joffrey Lauvergne joins Fenerbahce Dogus|date=July 4, 2018|work=fenerbahce.org|access-date=July 16, 2018}} Lauvergne had 12 points on 4-from-7 shooting, along with 4 rebounds in his [[EuroLeague]] debut versus [[CB Gran Canaria|Gran Canaria]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=7&seasoncode=E2018|title = Fenerbahce Beko Istanbul vs. Herbalife Gran Canaria - Game| date=21 May 2023 }} Over 22 [[EuroLeague]] games during the 2018–2019 season, he averaged 8.5 points, 3.6 rebounds and career-high 1.8 assists per game. ===Žalgiris Kaunas (2020–2022)=== On 14 July, 2020, Lauvergne signed with [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] of the [[Lietuvos krepšinio lyga|Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL).{{Cite web|url=http://zalgiris.lt/en/news/bc-zalgiris/90059|title=Zalgiris bolsters roster with former NBA big man|date=July 14, 2020|website=zalgiris.lt|access-date=July 14, 2020}}{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/joffrey-lauvergne-inks-with-zalgiris-kaunas/|title=Joffrey Lauvergne inks with Zalgiris Kaunas|date=July 14, 2020|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=July 14, 2020}} On 28 January, 2021, Žalgiris and Lauvergne agreed on a 1+1 extension deal until the end of the 2022–2023 season.{{Cite web|url=http://zalgiris.lt/en/news/bc-zalgiris/93200/|title=Zalgiris reaches contract extension with Joffrey Lauvergne|date=January 28, 2021|website=zalgiris.lt|access-date=January 28, He won the gold medal with France at the [[FIBA EuroBasket 2013|EuroBasket 2013]].{{cite web|title=Joffrey Lauvergne - EuroBasket 2013|url=https://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/player/p/pid/62278/sid/8722/index.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140917042203/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/player/p/pid/62278/sid/8722/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=September 17, 2014|website=fiba.com|access-date=22 September 2014}} The following summer, he won the bronze medal with France at the [[2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup|2014 World Cup]]. His role in the team increased, and he averaged 9.2 points and 5.3 rebounds over nine tournament games.{{cite web|title=Joffrey LAUVERGNE - World Cup 2014|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2014/player/Joffrey-S--M--Lauvergne|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140730144420/http://www.fiba.com/basketballworldcup/2014/Joffrey-LAUVERGNE|url-status=live|archive-date=July 30, 2014|website=fiba.com|access-date=22 September 2014}} ===International stats=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
